meta.label: Patch 26.24
meta.caveat: PBE content can change before release.
notes: Live is patch 26.23. This page lists what patch 26.24 changes.

Update 2026-11-18: patch 26.23 is live, so its changes left this page. The first patch 26.24 test build changes no Mayhem augments, Headliners or items. Akshan's Q scales more with AD (70% → 80%), and Goliath gets an extra effect for clones.
Update 2026-11-20 (patch 26.24): Surge Field returns to the augment pool.
Update 2026-11-21 (patch 26.24): Biggest Snowball Ever now starts small and slow, grows as it flies, and gains a stun and a knockback.
Ability values are listed for ranks 1-5 (basic abilities) or 1-3 (ultimates).

fame.summary: No new Fame bands on the test server yet.

superstarRank.summary: Fame also raises your Superstar Rank (10 milestones on its own track) and unlocks bands plus Audition Missions, which must be completed within a single game.

added.name: Surge Field
added.description: Gain the Surge Field summoner spell. Casting it creates a zone for 10 seconds: while in it, you gain 40% Movement Speed and 150 Ability Haste, and fire missiles at enemies that deal 30% of the damage you deal.

changes.pbe: 40%, growing to full as it flies
0.25 to 0.75 seconds, longer as the snowball grows
50 to 120 units, farther as the snowball grows

headliners.summary: No new Headliners on the test server yet.

championChanges.summary: Base-game champion changes on the test server. They also apply in Mayhem.

itemChanges.summary: Changes to items in the Mayhem shop. Runes are unchanged.
